name: Tialis Essential IT PLC
summary: Operating through its various subsidiaries, Tialis Essential IT PLC delivers a comprehensive suite of network, cloud, and managed IT solutions to both public and private sector organizations across the United Kingdom. Their cloud and hosting offerings encompass co-location facilities, a range of private, public, and hybrid cloud environments, disaster recovery and business continuity planning, and seamless cloud migration services. For connectivity, the company provides cloud linking solutions, multi-protocol label switching (MPLS), local and wide area networking, and robust protection against distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks. Collaboration tools include hosted telephone systems and unified communication platforms. Furthermore, their managed services portfolio features remote infrastructure oversight, on-site technical support including tech bars and dedicated personnel, field engineering ('smart hands') assistance, advanced threat mitigation, and expert professional consultancy. Finally, device management covers the entire lifecycle, from acquisition and initial setup to ongoing administration and secure disposal. The company rebranded from IDE Group Holdings plc to Tialis Essential IT PLC in November 2022. Established in 2005, Tialis Essential IT PLC maintains its headquarters in Edinburgh, UK.
